item.title: On the field at the Field of Ares, Akestgenes #923 and Euope #3060 saw each other across t
item.description: On the field at the Field of Ares, Akestgenes #923 and Euope #3060 saw each other across the spears. Their houses are guest-friends. They lowered their weapons, as Glaukos and Diomedes did, and 2 were spared.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Lykmedes #5944 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Lykmedes #5944 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to Iolcus. Lykmedes has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.title: Lykmedes #5944 the Twice-Born of the Argyreoi fell (brawl). Their bones go to the Asphodel
item.description: Lykmedes #5944 the Twice-Born of the Argyreoi fell (brawl). Their bones go to the Asphodel Meadow to mend.
